title: Kosovo’s Former Leader Is Sentenced to 25 Years in War Crimes Case
summary_full: A tribunal in The Hague found Hashim Thaci, who led Kosovo’s independence struggle in the 1990s, responsible for arbitrary detention, torture and murder.
